description: Consolidate-page-ONLY hero shell. Dual-rendered: DesktopHero (>=1024px, Lenis smooth-scroll + scroll-scrubbed Lottie snapping to 5 progress points) and MobileHero (<=1023px, ScrollTrigger play/reset + 3s-delayed replay loop), both wrapping the same section.hero.product content fields. This is the reason /consolidate is its own template rather than reusing template.product-landing verbatim for its hero node — but every node AFTER the hero (testimonial-slider through faq) is identical in sequence to /ruv, so the template still shares components/sections with product-landing beyond the hero.

responsive.desktop: Lenis-smoothed scroll drives a frame-scrubbed Lottie snapping to progress points [0, 0.26, 0.51, 0.76, 1] with a 0.6s power2.out tween; hero content parallaxes via translateY
responsive.mobile: Lottie plays once when the container crosses viewport middle (ScrollTrigger 'top 50%'), resets on leave, replays automatically 3s after each completion

motion.reducedMotionFallback: Lottie renders first frame statically, no Lenis smoothing, no ScrollTrigger play/replay loop, no parallax translateY
